title:
—A woful lunatic! Mulligan said. Were you in a funk?
 
 —I was, Stephen said with energy and growing fear. Out here in the dark with a man I don’t know raving and moaning to himself about shooting a black panther.
html_source:
Mulligan comments on Haines' nightmarish moaning and raving as a “woful lunatic” which is basically saying he’s a troubled man.

Then he asks Stephen if all of that caused him to grow nervous/fearful or depressed, Stephen replies it did; All the while getting more and more upset with the situation.

Funk being defined as depressed/fearful/nervous is clarified in the second sentence. “-I was, Stephen said with energy and growing fear.”

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: More than troubled, it suggests Haines is mad. The term lunatic is especially relevant because Haines' outburst has occurred in his sleep. ‘Lunatic’ is derived from the Latin word for moon, ‘luna’, something we can still see in ‘lunar’. The belief that madness is caused by the moon is a long-running one. Haines seems to obey the rule.
